mapper.insert: INSERT INTO delivery_order (order_no, sender_name, sender_phone, receiver_name, receiver_phone, from_station_id, to_station_id, goods_desc, weight, volume_cm3, quoted_price, state, approve_deadline, return_of) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{senderName}, #{senderPhone}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{fromStationId}, #{toStationId}, #{goodsDesc}, #{weight}, #{volumeCm3}, #{quotedPrice}, #{state}, #{approveDeadline}, #{returnOf})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM delivery_order WHERE return_of = #{orderNo} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE delivery_order SET state = 'RECEIVED', receive_time = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND receiver_phone = #{receiverPhone} AND state = 'DELIVERING'
UPDATE delivery_order SET state = 'RECEIVED', receive_time = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND state = 'DELIVERING'
UPDATE delivery_order SET state = 'SENDING', version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND state = 'DELIVERING'

UPDATE delivery_order SET state = 'REFUSED', refuse_reason = #{reason}, refuse_time = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND receiver_phone = #{receiverPhone} AND state = 'DELIVERING'

UPDATE delivery_order o SET state = 'CANCELLED', cancel_time = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo} AND o.sender_phone = #{senderPhone} AND o.state IN ('WAITING', 'AWAITING_RECEIPT', 'APPROVED') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_route r WHERE r.order_id = o.id AND r.depart_time IS NOT NULL)

UPDATE delivery_order SET sender_name = #{order.senderName}, sender_phone = #{order.senderPhone}, receiver_name = #{order.receiverName}, receiver_phone = #{order.receiverPhone}, from_station_id = #{order.fromStationId}, to_station_id = #{order.toStationId}, goods_desc = #{order.goodsDesc}, weight = #{order.weight}, volume_cm3 = #{order.volumeCm3}, quoted_price = #{order.quotedPrice}, actual_volume_cm3 = NULL, actual_weight = NULL, price = NULL, price_confirmed_at = NULL, price_confirmed_by = NULL, price_confirmed_operator = NULL, receipt_confirmed_at = NULL, state = 'WAITING', reject_reason = NULL, current_seq = NULL, current_station_id = NULL, cancel_time = NULL, approve_deadline = #{deadline}, resubmit_count = resubmit_count + 1, version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{order.orderNo} AND state = 'REJECTED' AND resubmit_count < #{maxResubmit}
UPDATE delivery_order SET state = 'REJECTED', reject_reason = '审批超时', version = version + 1 WHERE state = 'WAITING' AND approve_deadline < #{now}
mapper.sql: o.order_no AS orderNo, o.state AS state, fs.name AS fromStation, ts.name AS toStation, ns.name AS nextStation, o.current_seq AS currentSeq, o.forward_station_count AS forwardStationCount, nr.arrive_trip_no AS tripNo, o.goods_desc AS goodsDesc, o.receiver_name AS receiverName, o.receiver_phone AS receiverPhone, o.weight AS weight, o.volume_cm3 AS volumeCm3, (o.price_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL) AS priceConfirmed, cr.remark AS remark, o.create_time AS createTime
mapper.select: SELECT 'RECEIVE' AS bucket, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.state AS state, fs.name AS fromStation, ts.name AS toStation, NULL AS nextStation, o.current_seq AS currentSeq, o.forward_station_count AS forwardStationCount, NULL AS tripNo, o.goods_desc AS goodsDesc, o.receiver_name AS receiverName, o.receiver_phone AS receiverPhone, o.weight AS weight, o.volume_cm3 AS volumeCm3, (o.price_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL) AS priceConfirmed, NULL AS remark, o.create_time AS createTime FROM delivery_order o JOIN station fs ON fs.id = o.from_station_id JOIN station ts ON ts.id = o.to_station_id WHERE o.state = 'AWAITING_RECEIPT' AND o.from_station_id = #{stationId} ORDER BY o.create_time

SELECT 'DEPART' AS bucket,
FROM delivery_order o JOIN order_route cr ON cr.order_id = o.id AND cr.seq = o.current_seq JOIN order_route nr ON nr.order_id = o.id AND nr.seq = o.current_seq + 1 JOIN station fs ON fs.id = o.from_station_id JOIN station ts ON ts.id = o.to_station_id JOIN station ns ON ns.id = nr.station_id WHERE o.current_station_id = #{stationId} AND o.state IN ('APPROVED', 'SENDING') AND nr.status = 'PENDING' AND cr.depart_time IS NULL ORDER BY o.create_time

SELECT 'ARRIVE' AS bucket,
FROM delivery_order o JOIN order_route nr ON nr.order_id = o.id AND nr.station_id = #{stationId} AND nr.status = 'PENDING' JOIN order_route cr ON cr.order_id = o.id AND cr.seq = nr.seq - 1 JOIN station fs ON fs.id = o.from_station_id JOIN station ts ON ts.id = o.to_station_id JOIN station ns ON ns.id = nr.station_id WHERE o.state = 'SENDING' AND o.current_seq = cr.seq AND cr.depart_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY o.create_time

SELECT 'DISPATCH' AS bucket, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.state AS state, fs.name AS fromStation, ts.name AS toStation, NULL AS nextStation, o.current_seq AS currentSeq, o.forward_station_count AS forwardStationCount, dest.arrive_trip_no AS tripNo, o.goods_desc AS goodsDesc, o.receiver_name AS receiverName, o.receiver_phone AS receiverPhone, o.weight AS weight, o.volume_cm3 AS volumeCm3, (o.price_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL) AS priceConfirmed, dest.remark AS remark, o.create_time AS createTime FROM delivery_order o JOIN order_route dest ON dest.order_id = o.id AND dest.seq = o.forward_station_count JOIN station fs ON fs.id = o.from_station_id JOIN station ts ON ts.id = o.to_station_id WHERE o.to_station_id = #{stationId} AND o.current_station_id = #{stationId} AND o.current_seq = o.forward_station_count AND o.state = 'SENDING' AND dest.postman_id IS NULL AND dest.status = 'ARRIVED' ORDER BY o.create_time
SELECT * FROM delivery_order WHERE state = #{state} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE delivery_order SET state = 'AWAITING_RECEIPT', approve_by = #{operatorId}, approve_time = #{now}, forward_station_count = #{stationCount}, current_seq = 1, current_station_id = #{fromStationId}, version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND state = 'WAITING'
UPDATE delivery_order SET state = 'REJECTED', reject_reason = #{reason}, version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND state = 'WAITING'

UPDATE delivery_order SET state = 'APPROVED', receipt_confirmed_at = #{now}, actual_volume_cm3 = #{volumeCm3}, actual_weight = #{weightKg}, price = #{price}, price_confirmed_at = #{now}, price_confirmed_by = #{postmanId}, price_confirmed_operator = #{operatorId}, version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND state = 'AWAITING_RECEIPT'

UPDATE delivery_order SET actual_volume_cm3 = #{volumeCm3}, actual_weight = #{weightKg}, price = #{price}, price_confirmed_at = #{now}, price_confirmed_by = #{postmanId}, version = version + 1 WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND state IN ('SENDING', 'DELIVERING')
